name: Rockland to Carver's Harbor
note: Threads the ledges around Old Harbor, The Reach, and Green Island Knob into Carver's Harbor on Vinalhaven. Verified live 2026-09-12 as a hand-built route after direct AutoRoute fell back to a straight line on this corridor — kept here as both a sample route and a regression check for the router.

name: Rockland to Warren Island
note: Runs up West Penobscot Bay past Camden and Lincolnville, then curves around Warren Island's north end into the state park's mooring field. Verified live 2026-09-17 — AutoRoute threads this corridor cleanly; kept here as both a sample route and a regression check for the router.

name: Rockland to Perry Creek
note: Runs up West Penobscot Bay past Camden and Islesboro to the free moorings off Perry Creek's mouth on Vinalhaven/North Haven's Fox Island Thorofare side. Verified live 2026-09-18 — AutoRoute threads this corridor cleanly; kept here as both a sample route and a regression check for the router.

name: Rockland to Stonington (overnight at Perry Creek)
note: Two-leg passage: Rockland to the Perry Creek moorings (overnight stop, tagged on that waypoint), then on through the Deer Isle Thorofare approach to Stonington. Both legs verified live 2026-09-18 — AutoRoute threads each cleanly; kept here as both a sample route and a regression check for the router.

name: Rockland to WoodenBoat School
note: Long-range passage (~24nm) up through Eggemoggin Reach and the Deer Isle Thorofare archipelago to the WoodenBoat School's moorings in Center Harbor, Brooklin. Verified live 2026-09-18 after fixing a real router bug (a long-range transit bracket's clamped boundary could land on land itself, near the town of Deer Isle, with no nearby-water recovery) — kept here as both a sample route and a regression check for the router.
